description: Sampling-point mechanism is leaf-function + leaf-DSO only. Caller frames are a separate overlapping context dimension; Python business-operation attribution remains separate.

M-PY-INTERPRETER.upper_operation: unknown unless independent Python frame or a sufficiently specific native stack proves otherwise

M-PY-REFCOUNT.description: CPython reference count updates and object deallocation

M-PY-ALLOC.upper_operation: unknown by default; allocate/free direction retained only if symbol supports it

evidence: resolved CPython container leaf-function name; no broad substring-only match

M-PY-TYPECHECK.description: CPython type checks and subtype checks

M-PY-RUNTIME-OTHER.description: Resolved libpython function outside the narrower symbol rules

resolved zlib leaf function for inflate/decompression direction

evidence: resolved zlib symbol without directional function
Poppler-family DSO and pdftoppm/pdfinfo or raster stack context

M-UNCLASSIFIED.description: Unknown DSO, unknown symbol, insufficient stack, or otherwise unclassifiable native sample

execution_path_matching.method: Parse actual Python script operand and resolve its runtime path through Docker-installed legacy roots, runner workspace seed copies, and any exact recipe write to that path. Timestamped identity/ppid and cwd rules constrain which process receives the mapping.
runtime_roots: old OPM/TLC use source=None and /opt/document-bench/{pdf,xlsx} seeds; reset_workspace removes prior workspace then copytree(seed, workspace)
new datasets use DATASETS seed; source context is not assumed to be the executed script source
exact recipe write to script target supersedes seed content
evidence_levels: timestamped argv/path plus reconstructed source chain and matching archived content hash; runtime hash absent
timestamped path with deterministic source chain but content does not map to a selected slice
script operand candidate without confirmed runtime source chain
rules: A data argument, redirection, cat operand, or ordinary command text is not script provenance.
Parent context is inherited only for selected slices whose process scope includes children/threads/full helper window, using timestamped ppid relations.
Same basename, role, or source snapshot does not establish script identity.
Reconstructed repository/source hash is never presented as a historical process runtime hash.
Source snapshots are not selected where the actual Skill symlink or workspace seed path points elsewhere.

coverage_comparison.denominator: sum of raw cycles:u sample period over complete estimated workload ROI
dimensions: direct selected-script execution path from argv plus reconstructed install/seed/recipe source chain
sampling-point native mechanism from leaf function and leaf DSO
same leaf function and DSO class
eligible normalized stack-prefix fingerprint match (<=8 frames, >=4 resolved frames)
overlapping caller-context mechanisms, reported outside primary partition
coverage_comparison.formula: Execution path and sampling-point mechanism are separate sample sets; report each, their intersection and union. Leaf-function match and eligible stack-prefix fingerprint match are supplementary, separate dimensions. Context evidence is overlapping and never added to primary mechanism bins.
coverage_comparison.reference: Construct mechanism/function reference from samples attributed to old selected slices in same-environment OPM/TLC controls; new PDF comparisons use same N scale.

weight_method.interpretation: kernel-estimated period is an approximation of cycles represented per sample; independent py-spy is context only and is never proportionally assigned to native cycles.

stack_prefix_fingerprint.normalization: symbol name without +offset/address; DSO reduced with DSO_CLASS_RULES; inline frame DSO restored from same-address non-inline owner
stack_prefix_fingerprint.quality_filter: exclude any prefix with fewer than four frames or any unknown symbol/DSO from matching; retain with weak quality label for diagnostics
limitations: prefix match is not full callpath or code identity

context_evidence.method: Classify known caller frames independently and record frame index, stack depth, symbol, DSO class, context mechanism, and contextual confidence. Context categories overlap and may conflict with the leaf mechanism.
context_evidence.accounting: Never added to the mutually exclusive sampling-point mechanism partition; does not infer the Python business algorithm.
